mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acgn0721_gis.tb_xunlipoint ( id, xunliid, xunliname, gaoqingpic, ep, time, geopoint ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{xunliid}, #{xunliname}, #{gaoqingpic}, #{ep}, #{time}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{geopoint[1]}, #{geopoint[0]}), 4326) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY[ST_X(maingeo), ST_Y(maingeo)] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli WHERE zoom <= #{zoom}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.xunliname, b.xunlicolor, a.id, a.xunliid, a.xunliname AS point_xunliname, a.xunlipic, a.gaoqingpic, a.ep, a.time, ARRAY[ST_X(a.geopoint), ST_Y(a.geopoint)] AS geopoint, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.xunliid ORDER BY a.id DESC -- 按ID倒序确保取最新数据 ) AS rn FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunlipoint AS a INNER JOIN acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli AS b ON b.xunliid = a.xunliid WHERE b.zoom <= #{zoom} ) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 10 -- 每个分组保留最新5条 ) AS final_data LIMIT 400; -- 最多返回100条随机记录

WITH final_data AS ( SELECT *, -- 计算每个点所在的网格ID（将区域划分为20x20的网格） FLOOR((geopoint[1] - #{WsLng}) / ((#{NeLng} - #{WsLng}) / 20)) AS grid_x, FLOOR((geopoint[2] - #{WsLat}) / ((#{NeLat} - #{WsLat}) / 20)) AS grid_y FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.xunliname, b.xunlicolor, a.id, a.xunliid, a.xunliname AS point_xunliname, -- 别名避免字段冲突 a.xunlipic, a.gaoqingpic, a.ep, a.time, ARRAY[ST_X(a.geopoint), ST_Y(a.geopoint)] AS geopoint, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.xunliid ORDER BY a.id DESC ) AS rn FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunlipoint AS a INNER JOIN acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli AS b ON b.xunliid = a.xunliid WHERE b.zoom <= #{Zoom} AND a.geopoint && ST_MakeEnvelope( #{WsLng}, #{WsLat}, #{NeLng}, #{NeLat}, 4326 ) ) AS subquery WHERE rn <= 10 ) AS t ), sampled_data AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY grid_x, grid_y -- 按网格分组 ORDER BY random() -- 网格内随机排序 ) AS grid_rn FROM final_data ) SELECT * FROM sampled_data WHERE grid_rn <= 20 -- 每个网格最多取4个点 LIMIT 2000;

WITH view_bounds AS ( SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(#{WsLng}, #{WsLat}, #{NeLng}, #{NeLat}, 4326) AS envelope, (#{NeLng} - #{WsLng}) / 12 AS grid_width, (#{NeLat} - #{WsLat}) / 12 AS grid_height ), raw_points AS ( SELECT id, xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid, ST_X(maingeo) AS lng, ST_Y(maingeo) AS lat FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli WHERE zoom <= #{Zoom} AND maingeo && (SELECT envelope FROM view_bounds) ), grid_points AS ( SELECT *, FLOOR((lng - #{WsLng}) / (SELECT grid_width FROM view_bounds)) AS grid_x, FLOOR((lat - #{WsLat}) / (SELECT grid_height FROM view_bounds)) AS grid_y, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY FLOOR((lng - #{WsLng}) / (SELECT grid_width FROM view_bounds)), FLOOR((lat - #{WsLat}) / (SELECT grid_height FROM view_bounds)) ORDER BY RANDOM() ) AS rn FROM raw_points ), main_results AS ( SELECT id, xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY[lng, lat] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid, 1 AS result_type -- 标记为主结果 FROM grid_points WHERE rn = 1 ), backup_results AS ( SELECT id, xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY[lng, lat] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid, 2 AS result_type, -- 标记为备用结果 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY RANDOM()) AS backup_rn FROM raw_points WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main_results) -- 仅当主结果为空时执行 ) -- 合并结果并应用排序/限制 SELECT id, xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid FROM ( -- 主结果集 SELECT * FROM main_results
UNION ALL
-- 备用结果集（最多100条） SELECT id, xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid, result_type FROM backup_results WHERE backup_rn <= 100 -- 限制100条 ) AS final_results ORDER BY result_type; -- 确保主结果在前
SELECT xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY[ST_X(maingeo), ST_Y(maingeo)] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli WHERE xunliid = #{xunliid}
SELECT id, xunliid, xunliname, xunlipic, gaoqingpic, ep, time, ARRAY[ST_X(geopoint), ST_Y(geopoint)] AS geopoint FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunlipoint WHERE xunliid = #{xunliid}

SELECT xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY[ST_X(maingeo), ST_Y(maingeo)] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid From acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli WHERE xunliname ILIKE '%' || TRIM(#{information}) || '%' OR city ILIKE '%' || TRIM(#{information}) || '%'

SELECT xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY[ST_X(maingeo), ST_Y(maingeo)] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid From acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli WHERE bcimg is not null ORDER BY xunliid DESC -- 按 xunliid 倒序排序 LIMIT 7

SELECT xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY[ST_X(maingeo), ST_Y(maingeo)] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid From acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli WHERE bcimg is not null ORDER BY count DESC -- 按 xunliid 倒序排序 LIMIT 7

SELECT xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY[ST_X(maingeo), ST_Y(maingeo)] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid From acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli WHERE bcimg is not null ORDER BY RANDOM() -- 按 xunliid 倒序排序 LIMIT 7

SELECT sub.id, sub.xunliid, sub.xunliname, sub.xunlipic, sub.gaoqingpic, sub.ep, sub.time, sub.distancemeters, -- 子查询中的距离字段（唯一来源） ARRAY[ST_X(sub.geopoint_geom), ST_Y(sub.geopoint_geom)] AS geopoint FROM ( SELECT id, xunliid, xunliname, xunlipic, gaoqingpic, ep, time, ARRAY[ST_X(geopoint), ST_Y(geopoint)] AS geopoint_array, geopoint AS geopoint_geom, -- 子查询中计算距离并命名为distance_meters（唯一） ST_Distance( geopoint::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography ) AS distancemeters FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunlipoint ) AS sub WHERE xunliname IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sub.distancemeters -- 明确引用子查询的别名，消除歧义 LIMIT 3;
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) AS max_id FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunlipoint

SELECT id, xunliname, japanname, city, bcimg, xunlicolor, ARRAY [ST_X(maingeo), ST_Y(maingeo)] AS maingeo, zoom, count, hengpic, xunliid FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli WHERE maingeo IS NOT NULL ORDER BY xunliid LIMIT 8000;

SELECT b.xunliname, b.xunlicolor, b.city, a.id, a.xunliid, a.xunliname AS point_xunliname, a.xunlipic, a.gaoqingpic, a.ep, a.time, ARRAY [ST_X(a.geopoint), ST_Y(a.geopoint)] AS geopoint FROM acgn0721_gis.tb_xunlipoint a INNER JOIN acgn0721_gis.tb_xunli b ON b.xunliid = a.xunliid ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 28000;
